name: B10-0417/2025 (PPE) – Situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the Taliban to lift their restrictions on women and girls, especially after the August 2025 earthquake in eastern Afghanistan. It asks for women to get medical care, education and aid, and for female aid workers to be allowed to work. It wants the European Union to give more humanitarian money and to pressure Taliban leaders with sanctions. The Parliament also condemns the Taliban's treatment of women and their internet shutdown. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks the Taliban to lift bans on women's aid work, healthcare and education; this affects Afghan women and girls.
- It urges the European Union and member states to send more aid and consider sanctions on Taliban leaders.
- It supports holding the Taliban accountable through international justice; no concrete action is decided here.
